segments.snp2.8:1.1: Yasmā hi dhammaṃ puriso vijaññā, indaṃva naṃ devatā pūjayeyya;
segments.snp2.8:1.3: So pūjito tasmi pasannacitto, bahussuto pātukaroti dhammaṃ.
segments.snp2.8:2.3: Viññū vibhāvī nipuṇo ca hoti, yo tādisaṃ bhajati appamatto.
segments.snp2.8:3.3: Idheva dhammaṃ avibhāvayitvā, avitiṇṇakaṅkho maraṇaṃ upeti.
segments.snp2.8:4.1: Yathā naro āpagamotaritvā, mahodakaṃ salilaṃ sīghasotaṃ;
segments.snp2.8:4.3: So vuyhamāno anusotagāmī, kiṃ so pare sakkhati tārayetuṃ.
segments.snp2.8:5.3: Sayaṃ ajānaṃ avitiṇṇakaṅkho, kiṃ so pare sakkhati nijjhapetuṃ.
segments.snp2.8:6.1: Yathāpi nāvaṃ daḷhamāruhitvā, phiyena [piyena (sī. syā.)] rittena samaṅgibhūto;
segments.snp2.8:6.3: So tāraye tattha bahūpi aññe, tatrūpayaññū kusalo mutīmā [matīmā (syā. ka.)].
segments.snp2.8:7.1: Evampi yo vedagu bhāvitatto, bahussuto hoti avedhadhammo;
segments.snp2.8:7.3: So kho pare nijjhapaye pajānaṃ, sotāvadhānūpanisūpapanne.
segments.snp2.8:8.1: Tasmā have sappurisaṃ bhajetha, medhāvinañceva bahussutañca;
segments.snp2.8:8.3: Aññāya atthaṃ paṭipajjamāno, viññātadhammo sa sukhaṃ [so sukhaṃ (sī.)] labhethāti.

lines: Salilanti ito cito ca gataṃ, vitthiṇṇanti vuttaṃ hoti.
Kiṃ soti ettha “so vuyhamāno”ti iminā ca sokārena tassa narassa niddiṭṭhattā nipātamatto sokāro.
Kiṃ sūti vuttaṃ hoti yathā “na bhavissāmi nāma so, vinassissāmi nāma so”ti.
Adhippāyato pana yathā yo kocideva naro vuttappakāraṃ nadiṃ otaritvā tāya nadiyā vuyhamāno anusotagāmī sotameva anugacchanto pare pāratthike kiṃ sakkhati pāraṃ netuṃ.

Tatheva duvidhampi dhammaṃ attano paññāya avibhāvayitvā bahussutānañca santike atthaṃ anisāmetvā sayaṃ avibhāvitattā ajānanto anisāmitattā ca avitiṇṇakaṅkho pare kiṃ sakkhati nijjhāpetuṃ pekkhāpetunti evamettha attho daṭṭhabbo.
“So vata, cunda, attanā palipapalipanno”tiādikañcettha (ma. ni.1.87) suttapadaṃ anussaritabbaṃ.

324-5. Evaṃ bālasevanāya bālassa paraṃ nijjhāpetuṃ asamatthatāya pākaṭakaraṇatthaṃ upamaṃ vatvā idāni “yo tādisaṃ bhajati appamatto”ti ettha vuttassa paṇḍitassa pare nijjhāpetuṃ samatthatāya pākaṭakaraṇatthaṃ “yathāpi nāvan”ti gāthādvayamāha.
Sotāvadhānūpanisūpapanneti sotaodahanena ca maggaphalānaṃ upanissayena ca upapanne.
Adhippāyayojanāpi sakkā purimanayeneva jānitunti na vitthāritā.
